name: X-Wings
what: A winglet on a tall pylon at each sidepod shoulder beside the cockpit, with small end fences. Adds a new silhouette element no current part has.

name: Bridge Wing
what: A raised front-wing element arched over the nose on two struts off the main plane, so the nose reads through a gap.

name: Twin Beam Wing
what: Two stacked beam-wing planes between the diffuser and the main plane, with side mounts, clear of the rain light.

name: Double Diffuser
what: An upper diffuser deck stacked over the two legal tunnels, with its own outer walls, feed slots at the step and a raised exit lip.

name: Monkey Seat
what: A small twin-plane winglet on a single pylon over the crash structure, under the main rear wing.

name: Spoon Wing
what: The rear main plane gets a deep centre chord and narrow, dropped tips. The upper flap is the active-aero flap owned by another lane, so it stays flat and hides part of the shape.
